name: Zichri
overview: Zichri was a male warrior from the tribe of Ephraim, noted in Scripture as a mighty man. His role as a valiant fighter highlights his significance within the Ephraimite community during the time recorded in 2 Chronicles 28:7. No additional personal notes are provided about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Zichri means 'YHWH remembers,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning common in Hebrew names. This proper name, as recorded in 2 Chronicles 28:7, does not indicate that it was given directly by God but carries a reminder of God's faithfulness.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Zichri as a descendant of Ephraim, situating him within this prominent tribe of Israel. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no further family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zichri's mention as a mighty man of Ephraim underscores his role as a warrior of strength and valor in Israel's history. His inclusion in the biblical record reflects the importance of faithful and courageous individuals who contributed to the defense and leadership of God's people. While details are sparse, his name and tribal identity connect him to the broader narrative of God's covenant people.
